title: Skad
subtitle: Independent
description: Skad, a member of a Mos Espa street gang and the owner of a cybernetic right eye, joined up with the daimyo Boba Fett when he offered them a job. It was a step up from stealing water from water mongers like Lortha Peel. Then, in Fett's employ, Skad found himself defending the city from the Pyke Syndicate, who wanted to take over Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire for themselves.
